text:
alex: Hey team, quick favor. Im unexpectedly delayed flying back and I cant cover my primary block for Mon dawn (Mon 02:00-10:00 UTC). Can someone pick up the primary for the full window or split it? I can take evening instead. Sorry for the short notice.

rita: I can pick up Mon 02:00-06:00 UTC. Ill be on-call from a hotel but have mobile. Ken, can you do 06:00-10:00?

ken: I can take 06:00-10:00 but might be offline from 07:30-08:00 for a doc sync. If anything pages during that half hour, whoever is free please ack.

alex: thanks both. A couple of operational notes for the handoff: use this runbook for inference errors: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/paging/inference_errors. Key run commands are under "Quick mitigation".

rita: saw the runbook. Two quick Qs: what's the safe rollback command to switch the routing policy if model variant A degrades? And what's our customer comm threshold?

alex: rollback: ```redwood route set --service inference --policy fallback-variant-b --commit```. If you're rolling traffic, use `--dry-run` first to validate. Customer comms: if 5xx rate > 4% sustained for 15m => open a SEV-3 and notify support@redwood; if 5xx rate > 10% or p95 latency > 1500ms for 10m => SEV-1 and page SRE lead + exec.

ops-bot: Note: Weekend escalation window adjusted. Primary has 90s to ack before escalation to secondary; secondary then has 5m before SRE lead is paged.

rita: acking routing test to confirm pager routing. @pagerduty test-page service=inference reason="handoff check"

pagerduty: Test page delivered to rita via SMS + push. Please ack to confirm.

rita: acked. Push + SMS came through.

ken: small heads-up: last Friday we saw a flapping 429->502 pattern tied to GPU pool saturation during a heavy batch job. If you see rising 429s and then 502s check `gpu.pool_saturation/1m` and the batch job schedule. If saturation hits > 85% persistent, trigger partial traffic drain off that pool: `redwood pool drain --pool=ml-pool-3 --pct=50`.

rita: good to know. If I need to drain, should I also reduce batch size on the serving side?

alex: yes, reduce batch size first: `redwood config set inference.batch_size=8 --target=pool:ml-pool-3` then drain if that doesnt restore headroom. Also watch KV cache evictions: metric `kv.cache_evictions/5m`. If evicts spike while CPU is high it might be a memory pressure bug. In that case enable temporary prefix-cache mode per runbook.

ken: note for the handoff doc: Ive left contact info and my fallback (phone + telegram). Rita, DM me if you plan any traffic changes so I can cover the 07:30-08:00 window.

rita: will do. One more thing: is the customer impact message template updated? I want to prep the support message in case we need to notify enterprise customers quickly.

alex: yes template here: https://wiki.redwood.ai/comm-templates/customer-impact. Use the instance tag and include the SEV level + estimated affected requests per minute. For quick copy: "We are investigating increased errors on inference endpoints in eu-west-1. Our mitigation in progress is traffic fallback to variant-b and autoscale activation. We will update within 30 minutes."

ops-bot: Reminder: There is an ongoing staggered batch migration in eu-west-1 starting 05:00 UTC. Ops has moved most heavy jobs but a small reserved job will still run at 06:15 UTC and could spike GPU usage.

rita: noted. Ill watch autoscale headroom and GPU saturation closely between 05:30-07:30. If I see any >75% saturation Ill preemptively lower batch size and notify support.

ken: if you preemptively change batch size, ensure to communicate it in the slack thread and add a short note to the handoff doc so rotations know what was changed.

alex: agreed. Ive updated the schedule and marked Rita primary 02:00-06:00 and Ken 06:00-10:00. Leaving this thread as the on-call swap record.

rita: checklist done: pager tested, runbook read, comm template bookmarked, mobile confirmed. Ill post a quick status message 15 minutes into my window and another before the handoff at 05:45 UTC.

ken: will be around. If anything pages during my 07:30 offline, tag me in the thread and someone can ack.

alex: thanks folks. Travel sorted now. If anyone needs to swap again ping me and Ill try to re-arrange. :pray:

ops-bot: Note: This thread recorded as an on-call handoff. Automated reminder will post 30 minutes before Rita's shift.

rita: got it. Signing off until 01:50 UTC.

-- end of thread --
